links.outcome: Real-time expert adjudication of radiologist-AI discordances against concordance and unique diagnoses
links.effect: Overall concordance 97.79%; adjudication favored radiologist in 88.73% of discordances; unique diagnoses by radiologist 14.97% vs AI alone 0.81%.
links.quote: Expert adjudication favored the radiologist in 88.73% of discordances.

links.outcome: Radiologist interpretation of all cases alongside AI; unique PE diagnoses by radiologist vs AI alone
links.effect: Unique diagnosis by radiologist 483 of 3226 (14.97%), about 19 times AI alone (26 of 3226, 0.81%).
links.quote: The rate of unique diagnosis by the interpreting radiologist (483 of 3226 [14.97%]) was approximately 19 times that of the AI tool alone (26 of 3226 [0.81%]).

screen.reason: Evaluates a real-world clinical deployment of an FDA-cleared PE detection AI across >30,000 cases with a specific quality oversight safeguard (expert adjudication of radiologist-AI discordances).
